user.title: Connect to a TV
user.description: Enter the address and token shown in the GTV Live Stream app on the TV.

data_description.name: Optional friendly name, e.g. Master Bedroom TV.
data_description.token: Shown on the TV app's settings screen.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the TV. Check the IP, port and that the service is running.

show.name: Show overlay
show.description: Shows a live stream in a corner window on one or more TVs. Without a target it shows on every configured TV.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Camera entity with a stream source. Ignored when URL is set.

url.name: Stream URL
url.description: RTSP, HLS (.m3u8) or progressive MP4 URL the TV can reach. Required unless camera is set.
